rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for climate change, whether natural or caused by human activity.

example.english: Climate change is becoming more obvious this century, and even winters are not as cold as they used to be.

rows.note: Use this when focusing on human-driven global warming in everyday discussion rather than on climate changes more broadly.

example.english: Global warming is making summers hotter, and air-conditioning bills have gone up a lot because of climate change.
